Baltimore city vacant building notices per tract

Source: R/data.R
vacants_by_tract.Rd

This is the count all current vacant building notices issued by Baltimore as of 2026-10-05 per tract. This is just the points version of the vacants data, joined with the tracts shapefile and aggregated. Note that tracts without vacants won't appear here.

Usage

vacants_by_tract

Format

A data frame with 182 rows and 2 variables:

geoid

Character. FIPS code for the census tract

n_vacants

Integer. Count of vacant notices per tract

Source

Point data from Open Data Baltimore portal. Vacant Building Notices, available at https://data.baltimorecity.gov/datasets/691d65a5f85640e6aaa46930bd9dc102_1. Tract boundaries from U.S. Census Bureau, TIGER boundary files via the tigris package

Examples

 head(vacants_by_tract)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 2
#>   geoid       n_vacants
#>   <chr>           <int>
#> 1 24510010100         5
#> 2 24510010200         5
#> 3 24510010300         2
#> 4 24510010400         3
#> 5 24510010500         2
#> 6 24510020100         2
 # date dataset was downloaded
 attr(vacants_by_tract, "last_updated")
#> [1] "2026-10-05"
